evidence: The creator says the reusable guardrail skills have worked well across several game projects; they distinguish regression confidence from code quality or choosing the right change.

evidence_sources.excerpt: It might be the wrong change, and it might be crap code, but I can ship it without anything blowing up. I've been using it for a while across a few game projects and so far it's worked quite well.

source_story_title: Ask HN: How to deal with shipping AI-written code you don't understand?
